Capture a timestamp-based snapshot of system state for test scenario creation.

The snapshot capture system:
  - Records a precise timestamp when snapshot is initiated
  - Buffers write operations during capture (non-blocking)
  - Captures critical metadata atomically (object IDs, mtimes, hashes)
  - Reconstructs state from change journal if objects are modified
  - Applies scenario adaptors to transform baseline state

  Capture specific objects to test scenario
  zqk system snapshot-scenario --target test-scenarios/scheduler-optimization --object-ids SCH-001,SCH-002,SCH-003 --change-policy include
  Capture all scheduler jobs with adaptors
  zqk system snapshot-scenario --target test-scenarios/scheduler-test --kinds scheduler_job --adaptors id-remap,field-override --id-prefix TEST- --field-override status=active
  Dry run to preview what would be captured
  zqk system snapshot-scenario --object-ids SCH-001,SCH-002 --dry-run
  Capture with change journal reconstruction
  zqk system snapshot-scenario --target test-scenarios/exact-state --object-ids SCH-001,SCH-002 --change-policy reconstruct

Usage:
  zqk system snapshot-scenario [flags]

Flags:
      --adaptors strings                Scenario adaptors: id-remap,field-override,pii-filter,namespace,state-preserve
      --change-policy string            Policy for changes: reject, include, reconstruct (default "include")
      --columns string                  Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --compress                        Store snapshot in compressed format (.csnap file)
      --compressed-output string        Path for compressed snapshot file (default: {target}/snapshot.csnap)
      --dry-run                         Show what would be captured without creating snapshot
      --exclude-pii                     Exclude PII fields (default: true) (default true)
      --field-override stringToString   Field overrides (key=value, comma-separated) (default [])
  -f, --format string                   Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --id-prefix string                ID prefix override for adaptors (default: TEST-) (default "TEST-")
      --ignore-scheduler-down           Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --kinds strings                   Object kinds to capture (comma-separated)
      --namespace string                Namespace override for adaptors (default "test:scenario")
      --object-ids strings              Object IDs to capture (comma-separated)
  -o, --output string                   Write output to file
      --preserve-state                  Preserve object state (status, timestamps)
      --query-preset string             Query preset name from snapable trait (e.g., active_only, recent)
  -q, --quiet                           Suppress non-essential output
      --target string                   Target scenario directory (default: test-scenarios/snapshot-{timestamp})
      --timeout duration                Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                         Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
